title: memory
description: Predication-shape for a memory cell. A memory is a settled theory-extension a character carries across sessions. The four kinds (feedback, reference, user, project) specialize this shape via the has-kind discriminator.

name.description: Kebab-case slug, unique within kind. The cell-record's subject under the implicit-register encoding.

description.description: One-line summary used to decide relevance when the memory is offered for future-session loading.

has-kind.description: The kind discriminator. Each value is a sub-structure of memory via predicate-specialization.

belongs-to.description: The character (= directory, by polysemy) whose memory this is.

metadata.description: Claude Code auto-memory compatibility envelope. The 'type' field within MUST match the top-level has-kind when both are present.

type.$comment: When both has-kind and metadata.type are present they must agree.
